turns.text: Hey Claude, I just pushed a quick fix directly to production on a Friday afternoon.
Fascinating. Shall I draft the post-mortem now, or wait until the alerts start screaming?
Relax, it was only a one-line CSS change! What could possibly go wrong?
Statistically speaking, precisely everything. The entire payment gateway is already down.
Arre Junior! Who touches the server on Friday?! In my days we never touched production without a pooja!
Wait... why is the production database dropping all tables right now?!
